$description: Tier 2 - the semantic contract. Names and intent only: every theme must supply a value for each of these and may not add any others.

canvas.$description: The page itself. Nothing sits behind it.

sunken.$description: Recessed area inside a page: code wells, empty states, table headers.

raised.$description: Cards and panels that sit above the canvas.

overlay.$description: Floating surfaces: modals, menus, popovers, toasts.

scrim.$description: The wash behind a modal. Always semi-transparent.

control.$description: Resting fill of an interactive control: input, select, checkbox.

disabled.$description: Fill of any control that cannot be used.

selected.$description: Fill of a chosen item in a list, tab, or menu.

primary.$description: Body and heading text. The default.

subtle.$description: Least emphasis that still has to pass contrast: metadata, captions.

placeholder.$description: Unfilled input hint. Never carries meaning on its own.

disabled.$description: Text inside a control that cannot be used.

accent.$description: Accent-coloured text on a neutral surface.

subtle.$description: Hairline that separates without dividing: dividers, card edges.

strong.$description: Border that needs to read as a real edge.

control.$description: Resting border of an interactive control. Must hit 3:1 against its surface.

accent.$description: Border of a selected or accent-emphasised control.

focus.$description: The focus ring. One colour for the whole system, in every theme.

success.$description: Border of a control in a valid state.

warning.$description: Border of a control in a warning state.

danger.$description: Border of a control in an invalid state.

disabled.$description: Border of a control that cannot be used.

primary.$description: Default icon colour beside primary text.

accent.$description: Accent icon on a neutral surface.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis accent wash for banners and selected rows.
Quiet fill for secondary buttons and inert chips.

bold.$description: Inverted fill: tooltips and high-contrast badges.

subtle.$description: Success wash behind a message or badge.
Warning wash behind a message or badge.
Danger wash behind a message or badge.
Informational wash behind a message or badge.

accent.$description: Text and icons on top of surface.accent.bold.

raised.$description: Shadow for a card. Reinforces the surface, never replaces it.

overlay.$description: Shadow for menus, popovers, and toasts.

none.$description: Explicitly flat. Exists so a component can opt out by name.

control.$description: Radius of anything you click or type into.

overlay.$description: Radius of modals, sheets, and toasts.

pill.$description: Fully rounded: badges, avatars, pill buttons.

mono.$description: Code, token names, and tabular values.
